theorems.name: Submission.dohr_tp_graph_ball_growth
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (R ρ : ℝ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), 0 < ρ → ρ < R → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (z : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (graphOver u (ball 0 ρ) ∩ closedBall z r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ n)
